summary: Iteration 2 frontend testing completed end-to-end on the public preview URL. All 7 home cards render (including new 'activity-card-puzzle'). Puzzle drag-and-drop works via mouse events: all 3 slots can be filled and 'puzzle-done'/'puzzle-reset-btn' appear. Parent Dashboard exposes open-settings-btn, magic-moment-card with share/download buttons (download triggers anchor click via canvas.toBlob), 11 sticker cards with correct ids and 'X of 11' label, plus breakdown-puzzle card. ParentSettings exposes all required testids; clicking voice-gender-male toggles wood-card-blue and clears wood-card-coral on female; lang-es-ES gains wood-card-sage; bg-music-toggle text alternates between 'Turn on'/'Turn off'; localStorage key 'elise_voice_settings_v1' persists gender/lang/bgMusicEnabled across navigation. All 10 routes load. ONE CRITICAL BUG was found and FIXED in this iteration: /rhymes was throwing 'stopBgMusic is not defined' (and would have thrown for getSettings/startBgMusic/isBgMusicSupported on Play) because Rhymes.jsx referenced these symbols without importing them. Added the missing imports and re-verified — rhymes pick/play/stop now runs without console errors.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED during testing. Rhymes.jsx used getSettings/startBgMusic/stopBgMusic/isBgMusicSupported without importing them, causing the component to crash on mount-effect (stopBgMusic in cleanup) and on Play. Added missing imports from '@/lib/voice-settings' and '@/lib/audio-bg'. Verified no console errors after fix.

action_items: No remaining action items from this iteration. Iteration 1's wood-card-* CSS palette concern is no longer reproducible — those classes apply colors correctly (verified via screenshot of /rhymes selected pick rendering green wood-card-sage, and via class-toggle assertions in Settings).
critical_code_review_comments: Rhymes.jsx was missing imports for getSettings/startBgMusic/stopBgMusic/isBgMusicSupported — a lint/eslint-no-undef rule would have caught this pre-merge. Recommend enabling no-undef in ESLint config.
ParentSettings.jsx reads getSettings() during initial useState which is fine since it is sync localStorage; OK.
Puzzle.jsx attaches global mousemove/mouseup listeners only while dragging; cleanup is correct. touchmove uses {passive:false} which is appropriate for preventDefault behavior.
share-card.js downloadCanvas uses anchor element click — verified to fire (window.__dlClicked incremented twice = canvas built and anchor clicked). Works in headless.

voice-settings persistence verified via localStorage key 'elise_voice_settings_v1' — gender/lang/bgMusicEnabled persisted across full navigation. Rate slider input via direct el.value assignment did not persist in test (React's synthetic onChange requires nativeInputValueSetter), but other writes prove the persistence path works; not an app bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the missing-imports fix in Rhymes.jsx (was ~90% before fix because /rhymes crashed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://tiny-learners-60.preview.emergentagent.com. Pure client-side SPA. To test drag-and-drop in /puzzle use page.mouse.move(piece_center)->down->move(slot_center, steps=8)->up; iterate piece indexes 0..5 against each slot until the matching piece disappears from tray. To test download-moment-btn, override HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click to count invocations (canvas.toBlob is async so wait ~800ms after click). For React-controlled inputs (rate/pitch sliders), use nativeInputValueSetter pattern instead of el.value= to actually fire onChange. ESLint no-undef is currently NOT catching missing imports — flag if you see runtime ReferenceErrors.
rca of the issue: RCA — /rhymes ReferenceError 'stopBgMusic is not defined': Rhymes.jsx (lines 19,30,41) called getSettings/startBgMusic/stopBgMusic/isBgMusicSupported but the import block (lines 1-6) only imported speak/stopSpeech/trackOpen/trackTap/RHYMES/Layout/lucide icons. Reproduction: open /rhymes in any browser; React renders, then the play handler / cleanup effect throws ReferenceError (visible in console as 'An error occurred in the <Rhymes> component' + 'stopBgMusic is not defined'). Mitigation applied: added `import { getSettings } from '@/lib/voice-settings'` and `import { startBgMusic, stopBgMusic, isBgMusicSupported } from '@/lib/audio-bg'` to Rhymes.jsx. Verified post-fix by clicking rhyme-pick-0 -> play-rhyme-btn -> stop-rhyme-btn with zero console errors.
